bundle.shortDescription: Precision video slice downloader and local media converter
bundle.longDescription: Paste a YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, or X link, pick an exact time range, and render just that slice locally using FFmpeg. Also cuts out image backgrounds, transcribes audio to subtitles, and converts images, audio, video, documents, and PDFs — all locally. No servers, no uploads.
